title: Add owner check to validateApp + pass team from package.json in all 3 apps (mono only; lib is in-repo, no publish/major bump)

summary: validateApp (libs/shared-contracts, in-repo) now throws if app.team is missing; core-shell/billing/reports pass team matching their package.json (platform/payments/insights). PR #1 merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts is inlined at build time and not published, so no major version bump or platformkit change was needed; team values are hardcoded because the inlining build can't read package.json; the README bucket-name request was a separate item (README has no bucket names; docs/ci-cd.md does) and was left out of scope.
